decisions.reason: The BOM's current whisk_selection already incorporates the referenced whisk style for fine powder, so another MODIFY would duplicate existing state.
Selecting a whisk style for fine-powder mixing does not necessarily change the independent splash-control target.
The source specifies a whisk style and does not change the established 2.5-quart bowl capacity or bowl geometry.
The whisk-style reference does not alter bowl removal, swapping, or event-exchange behavior.
The source concerns the whisk component and does not modify spout removal, flushing, or cleaning requirements.
The whisk-style decision does not change valve operation, dripping constraints, or dispensing flow behavior.
The referenced whisk style is functional component guidance and does not modify the DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source does not entail any change to enclosure thickness, overall size, or accommodation of the bowl wells.
Whisk selection does not change the independent requirement that plumbing remain sealed and leak-free.
The whisk-style reference has no effect on the machine placard text.
Message 46 addresses only the whisk style; it does not decide the separate spout geometry or orientation concern.
The functional whisk reference does not modify the beige body or green accent colors.
